thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: PD-INC-87421 - node-gpu-ethernet-loss - Severity: P1. Remote host gpu-node-az3-12 lost kubelet heartbeat and marked NotReady. Alert: kubelet heartbeats missing > 45s. Metrics spike: pod evictions increasing. Pagerduty: https://pd.example/PD-INC-87421

pagerduty: Incident PD-INC-87421 created and routed to #eng-oncall. Escalation policy: oncall -> infra -> eng-leads.

sam: acked. I'm on it. Pulling logs and checking node. pinging @jen in case of customer impact.

jen: thx. any direct customer 5xx alerts? wondering if any host-specific customers are affected.

sam: checking metrics now. console to node, attempting SSH: 
```ssh ops@gpu-node-az3-12```
SSH times out. Serial console attach next.

kevin: I see a sudden NIC flaps alert on the rack switch at 2026-03-14T02:00Z in network logs for that top-of-rack. Might be L2. grabbing switch port.

sam: serial console attached. kernel shows repeated driver unload/load and then: 
```[ 10234.678901] NVRM: GPU at PCI:0000:65:00: GPU reset failed
[ 10234.678912] audit: type=1701 audit(1615804800.123:456): auid=0 ...```

sam: kubelet lost connection to CRI, then kubelet reported failed sync - lots of pods stuck terminating. Not clean kernel panic but driver-level instability.

infra-ops: on it, re-seating NIC on host via out-of-band. scheduling maintenance window now. Will try soft reboot after cordon/drain.

jen: tagging customer-impact. customer-success-bot - please flag any active customers using dedicated pools that map to az3.

customer-success-bot: Notifying CS triage for clusters: redwood-dedicated-alpha (2 customers), ml-saas-inc (1 customer). Sending email and paging CS.

sam: plan: 1) cordon node 2) graceful drain with --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data timeout 5m 3) if drain stalls > 6m, force terminate pods and trigger host reboot 4) follow up with postmortem.

kevin: recommend doing a quick kill of the hung nvidia-driver process first to see if kubelet recovers: 
```sudo pkill -9 -f nvidia && sudo systemctl restart kubelet```

sam: trying that now... 

sam: pkill succeeded but kubelet still not reconnecting. CRI error shows: unable to list containers: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: context deadline exceeded.

jen: proceed with cordon/drain. I'll open a customer incident and add affected clusters.

sam: cordon done: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-az3-12`

sam: drain started: `kubectl drain gpu-node-az3-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300`

sam: drain hit stuck pod: ml-runtime-monitor (terminating) referencing a hostPath. Not deleting. moving to force.

infra-ops: forcing eviction for stuck pods and initiating remote reboot via iLO/IPMI. Reboot scheduled in 30s.

sam: forced eviction completed. pods moved to other nodes, some failed pending node selectors. Rolling reschedules happening.

infra-ops: reboot in progress. iLO shows POST ok, kernel starting. Keep monitoring GPU driver messages.

sam: live metrics: overall cluster pod eviction rate returned to baseline. No increase in 5xx at the moment but some customers saw temporary model inference timeouts (~40s). CS notified.

jen: good. documenting customer impact: ml-saas-inc saw ~2 user-facing timeouts, redwood-dedicated-alpha had background batch jobs delayed. Logging incident for billing credits review.

kevin: after boot, plan to collect dmesg and NIC stats, NVMe SMART, and full vendor logs. Could be hardware flake.

infra-ops: host back up and kubelet rejoined at 02:12Z. kubelet logs show driver re-init succeeded, CRI healthy, node Ready. GPU drivers loaded.

sam: uncordoning: `kubectl uncordon gpu-node-az3-12` - pods can schedule. Moving to monitor for 30m.

jen: handing off to infra for root cause follow-up. infra-ops will lead the RCA and postmortem. I'll update PD ticket: PD-INC-87421 -> status: mitigated, impact: temporary timeouts for 3 customers, approx duration 12m.

infra-ops: acknowledged handoff. collecting vendor logs and opening hardware ticket with vendor (HT-20344). Will include kernel oops/driver traces.

sam: thanks everyone. leaving notes in oncall runbook. If anything regresses ping me. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PD-INC-87421 status updated to "mitigated" by sam at 1766000360. Follow-up: RCA owner assigned to infra-ops.

kevin: quick checklist for RCA: switch port flaps correlation, GPU driver version, recent firmware updates, rack power cycle history.

jen: I'll schedule a post-incident review tomorrow 09:30 PT. Invite infra, oncall, cs.

customer-success-bot: CS notifications delivered. Customers acknowledged; one asked for a brief summary to share with their ops.

sam: note added: tickets: PD-INC-87421, HT-20344, RCA-1766. Closing thread, moving to postmortem channel after RCA draft.
